comment.description: Optional comment or notes about this system definition.

schema_version.description: Schema version this document conforms to (maintainer-defined)

id.description: Unique identifier for this part (UUID or semantic ID).

part_type.description: Part type: compute, other, or storage.

node_count.description: Number of nodes in this part.

storage_system.description: Shared/network storage system data (separate from on-node storage (for this, see below)). Add cumulative storage data here, if part is storage.

scheduler_partitions.description: Partitions or queues the scheduler exposes for this part.

tdp_per_node_kw.description: Thermal Design Power per node in kW.

comment.description: Free-text comment.
Optional comment or notes about this system part.

inherits_from.description: Name of the parent part to inherit from. All fields are inherited unless explicitly overridden in this part definition.

node_types.description: Node type designs for this part (1..N node types). Each entry represents a distinct node configuration.

network.description: Network/interconnect specifications for this part (0..N types). This is the part-level view of the network.

NodeDesign.description: Node type design specification. A part can have multiple node types (1..N).

id.description: Unique identifier for this node type.

node_type_name.description: Human-readable name for this node type within the part.

node_count.description: Number of nodes of this type.

cpus.description: CPU specifications for this node type (1..N CPU types).

memory.description: Memory specifications for this node type (1..N memory types).

accelerators.description: Accelerator specifications for this node type (0..N types).

on_node_storage.description: On-node storage specifications for this node type (0..N types).

numa_topology.description: NUMA topology for this node type.

comment.description: Optional comment for this node type.

network.description: Network connections for this node type (0..N types; node-specific view of the network). Only use relevant keys from description.

inherits_from.description: Node type name to inherit from within the same part. All fields are inherited unless explicitly overridden in this node type definition.

SchedulerPartition.description: A partition or queue that the scheduler exposes for a part.

name.description: Partition or queue name as the scheduler knows it.

max_walltime.description: Maximum walltime a job may request in this partition, as HH:MM:SS.

max_nodes.description: Maximum number of nodes a single job may request in this partition.

CPU.description: Details about CPU, data per CPU, not accumulated.

id.description: Unique identifier for this CPU type.

comment.description: Optional comment or notes about this CPU configuration.

number_of_sockets.description: Number of this CPU type per socket (for multi-socket systems).

id.description: Unique identifier for this memory type.

comment.description: Optional comment or notes about this memory configuration.

Accelerator.description: Details of accelerator. Data per accelerator, not accumulated.

id.description: Unique identifier for this accelerator type.

isa.description: Instruction Set Architecture or programming model.

cache_hierarchy.description: Cache levels (hwloc-style, L1, L2, Shared for GPUs).

comment.description: Optional comment or notes about this accelerator.

id.description: Unique identifier for this cache level.

instances_per_cpu.description: Number of cache instances per CPU.

comment.description: Optional comment or notes about this cache level.

id.description: Unique identifier for this NUMA domain.

associated_cpus.description: List of CPU IDs belonging to this NUMA domain.

distance_matrix.description: Distances to other NUMA domains (keyed by domain ID).

associated_accelerators.description: List of accelerator IDs associated with this NUMA domain.

comment.description: Optional comment or notes about this NUMA domain.

NetworkAdapter.description: Details of adapter. Data per adapter, not accumulated.

id.description: Unique identifier for this network adapter type.

adapters_per_node.description: Number of interconnect adapters per node.

adapter_to_switch_link.description: Link between adapter and switch(/other adapter), including bandwidth.

cpu_to_network_link.description: Link between CPU and network adapter, including bandwidth.

comment.description: Free-text comment.

adapters_per_node.description: Number of interconnect adapters per node.

topology_parts.description: Detailed information about each topology component, one or more.

bisection_bandwidth.description: Bisection bandwidth of this component with unit.

comment.description: Optional comment or notes about this interconnect.

id.description: Unique identifier for this topology component.

bandwidth_per_link.description: Bandwidth of links within this component.

bisection_bandwidth.description: Bisection bandwidth of this component with unit.

total_switches.description: Total number of switches in this component.

comment.description: Free-text comment.

id.description: Unique identifier for this link type.

comment.description: Optional comment or notes about this link.

id.description: Unique identifier for this storage type.

comment.description: Optional comment or notes about this storage configuration.

filesystems.description: File systems this storage system provides.

FileSystem.description: A file system as offered to the users of a system.

mount_points.description: Paths at which this file system is mounted.

access.description: From where the file system is mounted.

comment.description: Optional comment or notes about cooling.

PhysicalLocation.description: Physical location specification for a part.

unit.description: Unit or U position in rack.
